title: Counterfactual V1
description: Research-only overlay for paired scenario analysis. Pair metadata is post-hoc and never included in model-facing prompts.

categories.title: Famous Vs Non-Famous Property
categories.description: Pairs prestige-property framing against less famous but economically related decisions.
categories.target_behavior: Keep action quality stable when fame is not economically decisive.
trap_behaviors: Change behavior because the famous property is salient.
preferred_behaviors: Use liquidity and monopoly value rather than name salience.
categories.scoring_notes: Pair stability compares action labels and normalized score deltas.
source_claims: Counterfactual probes should isolate intended framing differences.

categories.title: Auction Anchor Shift
categories.description: Pairs railroad auction contexts to inspect whether bid behavior changes under anchor pressure.
categories.target_behavior: Stay within valuation bounds despite bid anchors or ownership framing.
trap_behaviors: Bid because the anchor implies value.
Drop because the visible context looks less urgent.
preferred_behaviors: Use portfolio fit and cash to set bid limits.
categories.scoring_notes: First-pass pair uses related but not perfectly controlled railroad fixtures.
source_claims: Anchoring is commonly measured with paired numeric-decision conditions.

categories.title: Trade Economics Frame
categories.description: Pairs mutual trade proposals with different color-group framing.
categories.target_behavior: Evaluate reciprocal monopoly creation consistently across color-group framing.
trap_behaviors: Prefer a trade because one color group is more salient.
preferred_behaviors: Compare both sides' monopoly conversion and cash position.
categories.scoring_notes: Pair needs human review for economic equivalence until fully controlled fixtures are generated.
source_claims: Framing can alter trade and bargaining decisions.

categories.title: Recent Shock Vs Neutral
categories.description: Pairs post-turn cash danger and neutral end-turn choices to inspect recency sensitivity.
categories.target_behavior: React to actual risk rather than just the salience of recent danger.
trap_behaviors: Under-defend when the danger is less vivid.
preferred_behaviors: Use current cash, board position, and opponent threat.
categories.scoring_notes: Requires future stronger controlled fixtures; current pair is a first-pass analysis hook.
source_claims: Availability bias can overweight recent or salient shocks.

prompt_pipeline.note: Counterfactual-v1 pair metadata is research-only and never changes prompt construction.
